title: RNBuildConfig
description: Schema for .rnbuildrc.yml — the configuration file for react-native-build-orchestrator (rnbuild). Defines environments, build profiles, platform flavors, and Fastlane upload defaults for React Native projects.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL (optional, used by editors for autocompletion and validation)

projectName.description: Name of the React Native project. Used in command template substitutions ({{PROJECT_NAME}}) and iOS scheme defaults.

defaultEnvironment.description: Key matching one of the configured environments. Used as the default when no --env flag is provided. Must reference a key in the `environments` map — enforced by the rnbuild CLI at runtime (cross-reference constraints cannot be expressed in JSON Schema alone).

environments.description: Map of environment names to their configuration. Each key is an environment name (e.g., development, staging, production).

flavors.description: Platform-specific flavors/schemes for white-label or multi-variant builds.

android.description: Android product flavors (defined in build.gradle productFlavors block).

ios.description: iOS build schemes (detected from .xcscheme files in the ios/ directory).

fastlane.description: Fastlane upload configuration for automated store deployments.

lane.description: Fastlane lane name for Android uploads (e.g., upload_store).

defaultTrack.description: Default Google Play track (e.g., internal, alpha, beta, production).

packageName.description: Android package name (e.g., com.example.app). Used in the generated Appfile.

lane.description: Fastlane lane name for iOS uploads (e.g., upload_store).

defaultTrack.description: Default App Store Connect destination (e.g., testflight, app_store).

appIdentifier.description: iOS app bundle identifier (e.g., com.example.app). Used in the generated Appfile.

appleId.description: Apple ID email for signing and uploads.

builds.description: Build profiles for each build type. Three profiles are required: development, adhoc, and store.

development.description: Development build profile — typically debug builds for local testing.

adhoc.description: Ad-hoc build profile — typically release builds for internal distribution.

store.description: Store build profile — typically archive builds for app store submission.

BuildTargetConfig.description: Platform-specific build configuration for a single build type.

enabled.description: Whether this build target is active. Set to false to skip this platform for this build type.

command.description: Shell command to execute for this build target. Supports template variables: {{PROJECT_NAME}}, {{ENV_NAME}}, {{BUILD_TYPE}}, {{PLATFORM}}, {{FLAVOR}}, {{FLAVOR_NAME}}, {{FLAVOR_VALUE}}, {{FLAVOR_TASK}}, and any env var key.

outputHint.description: Expected output path or artifact hint. Displayed to the user after a successful build. Supports all template variables.

androidArtifact.description: Android output artifact type. Only relevant for Android build targets.

BuildProfile.description: Build configuration for both platforms under a single build type.

envFile.description: Path to a .env file relative to the project root. Variables from this file are loaded and exported at runtime.

vars.description: Additional environment variables as key-value pairs. Merged with and takes precedence over variables from envFile.

FlavorPlatformConfig.description: Flavor configuration for a single platform (Android or iOS). The default flavor value must match one of the options.

default.description: Default flavor/scheme to use when none is explicitly specified. Must match one of the configured options.

options.description: Available flavor/scheme names detected from the project or manually configured.

commandMap.description: Maps flavor names to Gradle task names or Xcode scheme names. Each key must correspond to an option in the `options` array. If not provided, the flavor name is used directly.
